message.essentialcraft5.corruption.gaine.en: Something suddenly feels different about you. What could it be?
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.gaine.zh: 你突然觉得自己哪里不太一样了。会是什么呢？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_0.en: Your hands suddenly feel too heavy to properly control!
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_0.zh: 你的手突然沉得不听使唤！

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_1.en: Your hands suddenly stop properly responding to your commands!
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_1.zh: 你的手突然完全不听使唤了！

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_3.en: Your legs suddenly become too slow!

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.body_4.en: Your legs suddenly feel very heavy!

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_6.en: Wait, did a creeper just pass by you?
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_6.zh: 等等，刚才是不是有只苦力怕从你身边走过去了？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_9.en: The item you are holding suddenly becomes too ugly to hold!
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_9.zh: 手里的东西突然丑得让你拿不住！

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_1.en: You suddenly use the item you are holding.
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_1.zh: 你突然用了一下手里的东西。

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: Everything seems to have skipped a second or two. Or was that just your body?
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 一切好像停顿了一两秒。还是说，停顿的只是你的身体？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The very air of this place burns!
You suddenly explode for no reason! Have you been eating creepers?
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 你突然毫无缘由地爆炸了！你之前吃过苦力怕吗？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: You suddenly catch fire from the heat of your own body!
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 你的身体热得自己烧了起来！

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: This lightning seems to ignore the laws of physics...
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 这道闪电好像不讲物理……

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: Your matrix protection weakens a little further.
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 你的矩阵防护又弱了一分。

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: Your eyes hurt when you look up. Your skin burns.
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 你一抬头，眼睛就刺痛，皮肤也烧了起来。

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The MRU corruption burns straight through your matrix.
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: MRU 腐化直接灼穿了你的矩阵。

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The very air of this place burns!
The very air of your home burns!
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 连家乡的空气都在灼烧你！

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The rain burns your skin! Is it acid?
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 雨水灼伤了你的皮肤！难道是酸雨？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The sun is too hot to stay under!
Why did you want to swim in acid, again?
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.zh: 你为什么又要跑到酸里游泳？

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.matrix.en: The wind tears at your skin!

message.essentialcraft5.corruption.gaine.en: Check a Soul Pentacle to see which one it is; the highest tier you have used can cure it.
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.gaine.zh: 去灵魂五芒星看看是哪一个；你用过的最高档就治得了。

message.essentialcraft5.corruption.first.en: Your MRU matrix has taken damage (from an MRUCU holding over 10,000 MRU, or a hit from an MRU weapon). If it builds up it can turn into corruption effects. Keep away from big MRUCUs, wall them off with plating, or wear MRU-resistant armor. See the Corruption Effects chapter of your Research Book.
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.first.zh: 你的 MRU 矩阵受了损伤（存满 1 万 MRU 的聚集体、魔力枪械的射线都会造成）。损伤攒多了会凝成腐化效果：离大聚集体远一点、拿护板隔开，或者穿上挡 MRU 的护甲。详见研究手册「腐化效果」一章。

message.essentialcraft5.corruption.prese.en: A large MRUCU nearby is damaging your matrix
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.prese.zh: 附近有存量过万的 MRU 聚集体，正在损伤你的矩阵

message.essentialcraft5.corruption.unloc.en: The Soul Pentacle sees your matrix. From now on, matrix damage can turn into any corruption effect: Body, Mind and Matrix ones. It takes a lot of damage to make one, so keep the damage low, and build a higher tier pentacle to cure what you cannot cure yet.
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.unloc.zh: 灵魂五芒星照见了你的矩阵。从现在起，矩阵损伤可能凝成任何一种腐化效果，身体类、心智类、矩阵类都有。凝成一个要攒很多损伤，平时别让损伤涨起来；治不了的，就去搭更高档的五芒星。

message.essentialcraft5.corruption.unloc.en: The Soul Pentacle sees your matrix. From now on, matrix damage can turn into Body and Mind corruption effects (Matrix ones never form in this world). It takes a lot of damage to make one, so keep the damage low.
message.essentialcraft5.corruption.unloc.zh: 灵魂五芒星照见了你的矩阵。从现在起，矩阵损伤可能凝成身体类、心智类腐化效果（这个世界里不会凝成矩阵类）。凝成一个要攒很多损伤，平时别让损伤涨起来。

corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_1.en: Your hand twitches on its own.
corruption_effect.essentialcraft5.mind_1.zh: 你的手不听使唤地抽了一下。

gui.essentialcraft5.player_pentacle.dorm.en: Dormant: does nothing until you open a complete Soul Pentacle you may use
gui.essentialcraft5.player_pentacle.dorm.zh: 潜伏：打开一座你能用的成形灵魂五芒星之前不会发作

gui.essentialcraft5.player_pentacle.dorm.en: Dormant: no pentacle tier can cure it here, so it does nothing
gui.essentialcraft5.player_pentacle.dorm.zh: 潜伏：这里哪一档五芒星都治不了它，所以不会发作

commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.en: %s has not opened a complete Soul Pentacle yet
commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.zh: %s 还没打开过成形的灵魂五芒星

commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.en: The highest Soul Pentacle tier %s has opened is %s
commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.zh: %s 打开过的最高档灵魂五芒星是 %s 档

commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.en: Set the Soul Pentacle tier of %s to %s
commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.zh: 已把 %s 的灵魂五芒星档位设为 %s

commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.en: Set the Soul Pentacle tier of %s players to %s
commands.essentialcraft5.corruption.tier.zh: 已把 %s 名玩家的灵魂五芒星档位设为 %s

affliction.essentialcraft5.heavy_hands.d.en: Mining is far slower and your swing drags (like Mining Fatigue).
affliction.essentialcraft5.heavy_hands.d.zh: 挖得极慢，挥手也变慢（和挖掘疲劳一样）。

affliction.essentialcraft5.weak_grip.des.en: Your attacks deal 25% less damage per level.

affliction.essentialcraft5.leaden_legs.d.en: You move 15% slower per level (like Slowness).
affliction.essentialcraft5.leaden_legs.d.zh: 移动速度每级慢 15%（和缓慢一样）。

affliction.essentialcraft5.paradox.desc.en: Ringing ears and a pounding heart; every so often the world before your eyes breaks apart.
affliction.essentialcraft5.paradox.desc.zh: 耳鸣、心跳，眼前的世界时不时碎裂、褪色、颠倒。

affliction.essentialcraft5.mru_corruptio.en: Leaked MRU eats at you: every second there is a chance of magic damage, higher at higher levels (level I never hurts). It deepens the longer you stand by leaking machines.
affliction.essentialcraft5.mru_corruptio.zh: 漏出的 MRU 在侵蚀你：每秒有几率受到魔法伤害，等级越高越容易中（I 级不伤人）。守在漏 MRU 的机器旁越久越重。

affliction.essentialcraft5.footer.en: A matrix after-effect: milk, totems and cleansing cannot remove it. Wait it out; it fades on death.
affliction.essentialcraft5.footer.zh: 矩阵后遗症：牛奶、图腾、净化都去不掉，只能等它过去，死亡时消散。
